inputs.description: Determines how Inferno will generate responses for appointment-book hook invocations.

inputs.name: appointment_book_selected_response_types
inputs.label: Response types to return from appointment-book hook requests
inputs.description:
Select the CRD response types that the simulated Inferno CRD server will [mock](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#mocked-responses) when responding to hook invocations.
              Because CRD clients must support the [Coverage Information](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#coverage-information-response-type) response type on this primary hook, Inferno will always include a Coverage Information response, even if it is not selected.
